## Update Available!
We’ve made some big improvements to **Food Tracking**, making it faster, smarter, and more flexible.
## Scan Barcodes
You can now scan barcodes from thousands of popular branded products using your smartphone camera — adds items to your Food Diary instantly.
## Custom Portion Sizes
Don’t see the portion size you need? No problem! You can now enter custom amounts to match exactly what you’ve eaten.
## Macros Made Easy
Get deeper insights into your nutrition with a breakdown of **carbs, protein, and fats** for the food you log.
